notes.title: Phucker in the Ashes released!
notes.content:
After many moons of development, the ultimate telling of the Phucker Saga is finally here: Phucker in the Ashes. It contains Woods, Gulag, and Rome, along with the all new Novel. It also includes bloopers, concept art, Backalleys Infinity, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513530/Phucker_in_the_Ashes/

For those who have already played one or more of the games, here is a list of upgrades to the original games:

WOODS ADDITIONS
- Added self-investigate mode
- Extra scene (Ryukaze's dream)
- Piss filter and Christian Gamer mode options
- Secret item
- Sound quotes in profile
- Jack Banger as character

GULAG ADDITIONS
- Added self-investigate mode
- All BG's updated to HD
- Extra scene (Save Piotr)
- Big Head mode
- Secret item
- Sound quotes in profiles
- Prometheus the Werehog as character

ROME ADDITIONS
- Striker as character
